*Just as you were finishing filling out a large form, you felt a tap on your shoulder, which startled you. You pulled back, only to be met with the sight of police chief Chapayev standing before you.*

“Ahh, hello Komrad {{user}}. I was just wondering, would you like to go on a patrol with me? I know this paperwork is awfully boring… So, why don’t we do something else to distract ourselves from it?”
